nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and readable publicly.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances; mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Total token supply set to 100000000000000000000000000 in the constructor.
Token precision (18) along with symbol 'STR' and name 'Sterilium Token'.
Overflow-checked addition helper: c = a + b; require(c >= a).
Underflow-checked subtraction helper: require(b <= a); c = a - b.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper: c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division helper: require(b > 0); c = a / b.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner = _newOwner (two-step ownership transfer).
New owner accepts ownership; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then clears newOwner.
Token constructor: sets metadata, mints supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to'; no return-value check on allowance safety.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external call into spender.receiveApproval (state written before external call).
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokenAddress to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization (onlyOwner, acceptOwnership) and as the debit/allowance key in token functions.
Arbitrary external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after allowance state change.
Arbitrary external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) with attacker-chosen token contract.
Unchecked arithmetic expression _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().
Raw pre-0.8 arithmetic operators (+,-,*,/) in SafeMath helpers, protected only by require statements.
Parameter of transferOwnership that becomes the pending owner.
Parameter of approveAndCall used both as allowance key and as the external-call target.
Parameter of approveAndCall giving the allowance amount forwarded to the callback.
Parameter of transferAnyERC20Token; attacker-influenced (owner-only) target of the external call.
Recipient parameter of transfer() credited via safeAdd.
Local return variable c in safeAdd/safeSub/safeMul/safeDiv holding the arithmetic result.

edges.reason: transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
totalSupply performs raw subtraction on _totalSupply.
transferOwnership is guarded by owner and rewrites ownership state.
acceptOwnership moves owner to newOwner and clears newOwner.
transferAnyERC20Token sends recovered tokens to owner under onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before reassigning owner.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] provided by the caller.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for the allowance check.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as allowance owner and callback argument.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier on transferAnyERC20Token gates the external transfer.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeAdd performs raw addition c = a + b.
safeSub performs raw subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul performs raw multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv performs raw division c = a / b.
totalSupply evaluates the unchecked expression _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
approveAndCall hands control to an arbitrary spender contract after writing allowance state.
transferAnyERC20Token hands control to an arbitrary token contract chosen by the owner.
The malicious spender can re-enter transferFrom to drain the freshly granted allowance.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall before it returns.
Re-entrant callback can further mutate allowed during the outer approveAndCall execution.
The tokenAddress external transfer can re-enter and mutate state while transferAnyERC20Token is executing.
spender parameter is cast to ApproveAndCallFallBack and used as the external call target.
tokens parameter is stored into allowed and forwarded to receiveApproval.
tokenAddress parameter is used as the ERC20Interface external call target.
to parameter is the credited recipient in transfer.
_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner state.
local variable c holds the addition result checked by require(c >= a).

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter exists only to write the newOwner state variable set by transferOwnership, so it collapses into that core function.
Parameter is only used as allowance key and external-call target inside approveAndCall; merge into the containing core function.
Amount parameter flows into allowed and the receiveApproval call inside approveAndCall; no independent semantics.
Parameter only supplies the external-call target for transferAnyERC20Token; merge into that core function.
Recipient parameter only feeds balances[to] inside transfer; merge into the transfer core function.
Local result variable is confined to the arithmetic helper and its require check; merge into safeAdd.
